title: VisionToAgentObservation
description: Perception observation produced by OpenCV 5 vision pipeline for deterministic agent policy

stable.description: Whether camera frame is sufficiently stable for high-confidence inference

corridor_divergence.description: Flow divergence score measuring forward movement into corridor

edge_density.description: Fraction of edge pixels in navigation corridor

blocked_score.description: Estimated probability/heuristic that the central path is obstructed (0.0 to 1.0)

cls.description: Detected class label (e.g., person, chair, bicycle)

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates [x1, y1, x2, y2]

growth.description: Ratio of bounding box area expansion relative to prior tracked frame (>1 indicates approach)

zone.description: Horizontal corridor zone of the object

text.description: Extracted OCR text if text reading pipeline was invoked, or null

text_confidence.description: Mean confidence score for recognized text (0.0 to 1.0)

text_clipped.description: True if detected text intersects frame border indicating reframing is required

fast.description: Execution time in milliseconds for fast-tier pipeline

detect.description: Execution time in milliseconds for detector tier, or null if skipped

ocr.description: Execution time in milliseconds for OCR tier, or null if skipped

status.description: Pipeline execution health status (ok, degraded, error)
